evidenceText: Teams can capture, classify, prioritize, assign, and route incoming work from any channel into one consistent front door.
Teams can organize approved work into time-boxed cycles, preserve originating context, and track progress against capacity.
Teams can create product and technical documentation and link it directly to the execution work it describes.
Existing issues and historical backlog items can be imported from Jira.
Enterprise plans support SSO configuration, including Okta, for production environments.
Per-engineer capacity calculations and load forecasting are available in controlled beta.
Native SAP integration is not currently generally available. Target Q1 2027.
Native Oracle Fusion integration is not currently supported and is not planned.
